newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Sino Commercial Prop MBS notes single-A.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Sino Commercial Prop MBS notes single-A.

text.p: Standard and Poor's has assigned a single-A long-term credit rating to Sino Commercial Properties Funding Ltd's US$300 million floating rate notes due 2003, S&P said on Wednesday.
The notes are secured by two mortgage loans.

S&P said the single-A rating reflects the strong debt service ratios and loan-to-value ratios of the two mortgage loans, the interest reserve acounts, the reserve funds and additional retention of surplus cash flows in the reserve funds, a swap agreement provided by Morgan Stanley Capital Services and guaranteed by Morgan Stanley Group Inc (rated A-plus) to cover interest and currency risks, and the mechanics and legal structure of the transaction.
In assessing the transaction, S&P said it also considered the volatitlity of the Hong Kong property market.
The properties underlying the transaction are ultimately owned by the Ng family and its listed affiliate Sino Land Co Ltd.
